nom: good light Cosmic Dew Gel To Foam Water Cleanser

avis.texte: Since the cleanser only says "free of artificial fragrances," as opposed to "unscented," I thought it would have a very subtle pleasant smell. I didn't think it would nauseate me in the way that unscented products tend to. Unfortunately, it very much did. I couldn't make myself use it more than twice. To be fair, it did seem to be a good and effective cleanser, and most people aren't going to have my weird issue with "unscented stink" lol.

I purchased this wanting to try out a new cleanser as the one I normally use gets a little expensive to purchase regularly. I was excited at the user experience at first, the cleanser foams up and feels very nice on the skin! However, within a week of use day and night I found my skin dried up and became flaky in spots. I have combination skin, and this usually doesn't happen to me as quick or to the level this cleanser caused. Really sad because I wanted to love this product!

avis.titre: the BEST cleanser I've ever used
avis.texte: yes i bought this with my own money! I was going through a horrendous breakout and my barrier was so damaged. I love the moisturizer so i took a chance on this. My skin feels so squeaky clean yet hydrated. After using this for only 24 hours, the red bumps around my chin and dermatitis around my nose was barely noticeable. I also love that its a thicker gel you have to squeeze out because other gel cleansers ive used are thin and harder to control. I can ger exactly a dime size amount without accidentally squeezing too much and wasting product. The actual company is also so lovely and i feel comfortable giving them my money!

I can agree with everyone in the reviews that the packaging unfortunately is unwell. I thought I can go uses without any issues anyways the product overall is great. I struggle with hormonal acne and this doesnt trigger it, my skin feel hydrated and healthy everytime i use it. It also cleanses my face enough with it prevent blacheads. Overall would buy again, hopefully they can change the packaging.

really love this as a 2nd cleanse following an oil cleanse. removes residue and oil and leftover makeup but is completely non-drying. my biggest issue is that the hole the product comes out of is so small I have to squeeze until my hand hurts to get out an adequate amount. the design is clearly to prevent oozing and product loss which is great, but man is it hard work to get a good dollop out lol

avis.titre: This cleanser deserves all its flowers!
avis.texte: This cleanser is amazing!!! Great for sensitive skin and anyone dealing with fungal acne or dermatitis. I am prone to barrier issues and deal with dermatitis flares pretty often. This has not caused any issues and my barrier is thriving. I am very happy to put my vanicream on the back burner.

avis.titre: This product makes my face feel happy
avis.texte: After using this cleanser my face feels so soft and so clean. It is so gentle and sudses well. It is my favorite product in my daily skin care routine.
Love this cleanser so much, started using it religiously for a little over a year now and it does the job, literally have no complaints.

My go to! It is a good gentle cleanser. Doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped. Only con is that sometimes the hole where the product comes out can be very tiny. The first one I ever bought had a really tiny hole and I thought that was normal but the other ones that I bought had a bigger hole and it was a little easier to squeeze out.
I adore this cleanser. Its great for my sensitive skin that can get dry, I live in a cold area. This cleanser is gentle, feels good on my skin, and works really well with my routine.
I've been ising this face wash for the last 2 years and it has completely changed my skin. Its hydrating, gentle, and makes my skin feel so soft! My boyfriend loves it I always come back to buy MORE!
I've been ising this face wash for the last 2 years and it has completely changed my skin. Its hydrating, gentle, and makes my skin feel so soft! My boyfriend loves it I always come back to buy MORE!

Honestly I really wanted to love this, but nope. If you have very sensitive skin especially, don't recommend. My skin will be super dry the rest of the day after i use this and that rarely happens with so many face washes I've tried as someone with eczema and hyper sensitive skin. I stick by and recommend The Niacinamide face wash by naturium instead

This is genuinely one of my favorite cleansers; and I have tried many. I have acne-prone combination skin and this cleanser goes deep enough to deal with the oils and sebum in my skin but is still creamy enough to feel non-stripping. Very happy with this product.

I absolutely love this cleanser. It always leaves my face feeling so smooth and soft without drying it out. It lathers pretty well especially if you use a cotton pad or soft cloth. I've traveled with it several times and haven't had any issues with the packaging failing during flights. I use less than a dime size and it lasts me a decent amount.
My favorite cleanser. Its gentle on the skin while still removing makeup, oils, and dirt. Have been using over a year. Love all the goodlight skin products.

avis.titre: Great 2nd step cleanser. Packaging could be improved.
avis.texte: Ive purchased around 6 of these at this point. It doubles as a moisturizing rinse off mask! Towards the end of the product, its difficult to extract from container but thats similar to most cleansers or lotions. Also, dont leave this dispenser side down or product could ooze out.

As far as "fragrance-free" cleansers go, this one actually smells pretty nice- unlike others that have almost triggered my gah reflex. It lathers a little, so if you like your face wasj sudsy, this one's for you. It cleans without stripomg, my face does not feel dry. Its overall a solid product! What I will talk about is the packaging- the little needle stopper inside the cap that keeps the insides from coming out, somehow broke into and got stuck in the dispensing hole?! I was struggling to get the product out obviously, and frustrated, I removed the broken plastic piece and of course, now there was nothing holding the cleanser back. This would have been okay, had I not traveled with it. Good thing I had the foresight to put it inside a ziploc bag, because the cleanser spilled its contents EVERYWHERE. It wasted so much!!Anyway. This cleanser is solid, just be careful with the packaging. Unsure if I'll repurchase but if I do, I'll most likely funnel it into another bottle.

avis.titre: good product with a few downsides
avis.texte: great gentle cleanser. doesn't dry my skin out after use, and it gets my makeup off (aside from a bit of more stubborn eye makeup) but i do notice i have to use quite a bit of it to get it to lather. and i kind hate the packaging, u rlly gotta squeeze to get the product out. plus the product tends to goop up and dry around the lid/spout which is gross.

I really wanted to love this cleanser, but it just required me to use so much of the product to get a good lather and remove my makeup. I'm sure it works well if you don't use a brow freeze but for me it just isn't doable. Returned.

I bought this along with another cleanser as I needed to find a new cleanser/face wash. Out of the 2 I purchased, I was really excited to try this one. I spot tested it in several areas before using it on my whole face and had no reactions so I figured I was good to go. I liked that the good light cosmic dew cleanser gave a good lather when I rubbed it between my hands and massaged it on my face. I also liked that had a better smell than the other cleanser and it felt better on my face and rinsing off, the other cleanser made my face feel a bit squeaky, if that makes sense. BUT this good light cosmic dew cleanser broke me out terribly where the other one did not. I'm really disappointed as I loved everything about it except it made my skin worse than it was before I used it. It took awhile to get my skin back to normal. I have combo, more on the oily side, very sensitive skin for reference.

I started using this product because of the fantastic reviews, and it simply did not live up to its expectations. It didn't help my acne AT ALL, and it even broke me out. I have combination skin and my forehead and nose doubled in visible pores. Terrible.

I bought this face wash during a sale, as I've been trying to replace all my skincare with cleaner items and this sounded like it had potential. I don't expect much lather from the clean brands so that isn't an issue for me, but this isn't a cleanser that I could rely on at night to wash the day away. It does not remove makeup well at all, and there are clean brands that make cleansers that absolutely will. This has become my go-to morning cleanser while I use it up. It doesn't irritate my skin or cause any issues, and a little goes a long way. I'm on the fence about whether or not I'd repurchase, though.
Worked well for my skin. Doesnt lather as much as i thought it would. Does not strip moisture but leaves a clean feeling. Smell is okay… could be better.

avis.titre: GREAT face wash, esp for combo skin!
avis.texte: My simple and effective skin care routine for about 3 months now includes; washing face daily with Good Light Cosmic Dew Cleanser for at least 1 minute. Immediately after, I apply & pat in with my hands Good Molecules Hyaluronic Essence, Good Molecules Hyaluronic Serum & Good Molecules Super Peptide Serum. I then finish off with Cetaphil Oil Free Hydrating Face Moisterizer. My skin HAS NEVER, EVER LOOKED OR FELT THIS GOOD, SERIOUSLY! NO ACNE flareups for first time in my life! This face wash is gentle, cleans face, removes oil, dirt & makeup, doesn't strip skin barrier, NO reaction, combo skin approved, face glows and super hydrated!! Great product!

I love using this face wash. I have combo skin and I thought it did a nice job balancing my skin without stripping it. I appreciate that you can use this product as a hydrating facial mask too! This kept my breakouts at bay and really tempered my skin

avis.titre: It's called "water cleanser" for a reason
avis.texte: Basically the exact equivalent of using just water and no face wash at all, because it absolutely does NOTHING. I was shocked and horrified to see that I still had a full face of makeup left on after rubbing a cotton pad with micellar water on it after using this "face wash." I wasnt expecting a deep cleanse per se, but atleast something more than this. Could be good for someone who doesnt need much cleansing, but absolutely way too gentle/ pointless for me.
This product is gentle on my skin and keeps my skin clear of break outs. A little amount goes a long way.

I got the worst breakouts ive had in years using this. It had almost stopped and then came back with a vengeance when i used this again. I do have sensitive skin, so im not sure if this caused them or if it simply didnt clean my skin enough to prevent them.

Stumbled upon this brand while shopping at Ulta. Loved the packaginng and saw the great reviews. By far a current staple for my water based cleanser. I use this after using a cleansing balm. The texture is gel like that lathers very well on the face, like a creamy foam. Cant beat the price! Switched from DE Jelly Cleanser to this, and love that I am saving and getting the same effects. Go buy it!

The texture is like nothing I've ever experienced—it really does feel like morning dew drops or unicorn tears. I find this does an unparalleled job at both the evening take-off as much as it preps my face for the day skincare regimen. Ran out recently, and returned to another cult favorite cleanser, and babes, it just ain't the same!!
This stuff is really nice, I like the gel to foam aspect. My only negative is that it kinda smells like pool water, but maybe that's just my crazy nose
I love this stuff. My skin feels so clean and firm without being dry. Definitely my new fave!!

avis.titre: Good Light has helped my skin
avis.texte: Since covid started wearing masks made me break on and I couldn't get the cycle of breaking out to stop until i tried this line. It didnt take long to clear my breakouts on my cheeks

avis.titre: great for my sensitive dehydrated skin
avis.texte: does a great job of cleansing the skin without fully stripping it, which is necessary for my flakey dehydrated skin, but still making the skin feel fully clean. highly recommend, along with the rest of good light's products.
Best cleanser I have found for my face! Always leaves my skin feeling super soft and not tight at all!!
This has been my go to cleanser for a while now. It's really gentle and not overly drying.

I have tried soooo many face cleansers. This is by far my favorite 🤩 I just use about a marble sized amount and dot it on different areas of my face, rub it in then wet my hands and massage my face and neck — a little goes a long way. I have pale sensitive skin and this has never caused breakouts after using it for about a year. So many cleansers either are too harsh and dry my face out and/or cause breakouts or too gentle and are not suitable for removing dirt, oil, makeup, etc. This cleanser is gentle yet effective. I would recommend it to anyone:)

avis.titre: My favorite cleanser of all time
avis.texte: Im on my third bottle of this cleanser and honestly my only complaint is that i wish it came in a value size! I tried this whole line from goodlight last fall and i fell in love. Every product from goodlight has worked so well for me but this is the product i recommend to everyone because its just the best simple face cleanser ive ever come across.

it's nice, foams up well which i enjoy. and it's got hyaluronic acid which is perfect for my dry skin. will probably repurchase down the line, but i like trying a new face wash every time i empty a bottle

For a "dewy moisturizing" cleanser my skin felt quite dry afterward. Does lather well, I'm trying to do more natural ingredients. This is very reminiscent of the neutrogena cleanser without the orange color.

I never write reviews but this product blew me away!! I have very dry and sensitive skin and this cleanser completely changed my skin! It made all of the milia bumps on my chin go away and my skin has never been so soft and smooth!

I really wanted to love this and at first it seemed to clean my skin but day by day bumps and acne would appear more on my forehead and I have very sensitive and combination skin and now it won't go away every time I use this :(

So I am going to be honest, I really bought it for the packaging. BUT I didn't know how desperately my skin needed this. I have combo skin leaning more towards oily, sensitive skin, and adult acne scars. This product makes me skin look and feel amazing! The price is a little high, but you only need to use a little. A little bit goes a long way, so it's should last you a bit.l

i've always wanted to try this seeing how it has a really good score on the yuka scale. so i finally decided to try it and it's amazing, not stripping at all. my skin feels clean but not stripped. i use this when my skin becomes irritated from my more abrasive face washes and it brings my skin back to normal even feels like it heals my skin. i love it!!

I use this as the first cleanse in my double cleansing routine at night as I have dry skin. Does a super good job at getting rid of my makeup/dirt/spf/etc. so if my face is left feeling a little tight I'll go in with second cleanser which is the gentle hydrating cleanser from la roche posay < 3 I stopped using cleaning balms because I felt they didn't really do much for me so this was an amazing switch🥰 loveeee!!
I have tried several face washes but I am set on this one! I have all of the products expect the lip balm one. I have oily skin and this definitely helps control it! Love it all

I ran into Ulta because I needed a new cleanser. I've been using a bunch of high end ones, but wasn't really impressed by any. I've had my eye on Cosmic Dew so I thought I might as well give it a try since it's so fairly priced. I've only used it a handful of times so far but omgsh. This cleaner has exceeded my expectations. I feel so hydrated, paired with my other products. This acts like a very high end product. Plus, it's great for travel as well! if you have been eyeing this, this is your sign to buy!
I just bought this because I needed a new cleanser and have been wanting to try this brand for a while and I'm so glad I did. The texture of this cleanser is heavenly. It is a new favorite for sure

avis.titre: Cleared up my skin so fast!
avis.texte: I had run out of my previous cleanser (different brand) and my skin was in need of a new one fast. Then I found this brand and I don't ever think I'm going back! I'm 19 and have combination skin that can tend to be on the dryer side sometimes and this cleanser hydrates my skin so much while also getting rid of my makeup, dirt, and oils. 10/10 recommend to people with combination skin.

I have been trying to find more cruelty-free skincare, and this is the best cruelty-free cleanser I've used! You don't need a lot, especially in the morning. It's effective, unscented, and doesn't leave my skin tight or too shiny. Your skin will thank you! The only reason it's not 5 stars is that I haven't noticed a huge difference in my skin, but it's a very good cleanser!

avis.titre: Beautiful soap if that's a thing
avis.texte: This soap has no scent, which is nice, it also looks so pretty, weird I know. Nice soapy suds, face feels refreshing and clean!

I've struggled with seborrheic dermatitis for the last ten years, leaving my nose, eyebrows, and forehead/hairline red, itchy, and flakey. Finally, after ten years of trying and failing different products, RELIEF! This cleanser is perfect and affordable. A little bit goes a long way. I use this every day with the microbiome serum and an SPF moisturizer and can finally say my skin is smooth, healthy, and flake-free!
MY HOLY GRAIL! It's my favoritest! LGBTQIA+🏳️‍⚧️ skincare! Vegan, Cruelty-Free, Clean Ingredients, & No Paraben & NO SULFATES!!

I love that this cleanser doesn't have artificial fragrance added. It gently cleanses and leaves your skin soft and fresh. I also love that you can use it as a quick mask for extra hydration. I use it as the 2nd step in a double cleanse but you could just as well use it as a single step cleanser. I will definitely be buying this product again.

First off, I'll just say that the entire branding/marketing of good light is right up my alley! I'm a sucker for anything celestial/ethereal themed and I'm happy to say the products have met my expectations! The cleanser is wonderful. It's gentle, effective, and doesn't leave my skin feeling tight. I've been searching for a cleanser that isn't too expensive and this one checks my box!

I've been using this cleanser for more than 6 months at this point probably, and it is easily my favorite. The lather I can only describe as "luxurious," it's so soft and feels great on the skin. I have super sensitive skin, and this is one of the few that doesn't break me out.

This cleanser delivers results instantly! I saw a change in my skin after 1 use. Brighter, clearer, smaller pores. A little goes a long way since it foams up, and the price point can't be beat for the quality of the product. In my experience it's not easy finding high quality plant based skincare, but this whole brand is a miracle.

I had a feeling when I bought this based on reviews and ingredients I would love it...and I do! I have very sensitive, acne prone combo skin type. I react to anything and have to be careful. Been on my skincare journey long enough to figure what ingredients my skin likes best and what does & doesn't irritate it for the most part. This cleanser has not irritated or broke me out at all, reduced size of current atress acne significantly over night and calmed redness, removed traces of my makeup, dirt and oil, very hydrating and lathers great. Love that it has no harmful ingredients, has vitamin E & hyaluronic acid, no alcohols or artificial fragrances and is affordable. Def makes me want to look more into brand.

This cleanser does work! It is great for washing off the day and does a great job at it. I also love that it is fragrance free and not full of terrible ingredients. I feel good about using this product!

My skin feels clean and this cleanser does the job with cleansing my skin without making it feel dry and stripped and has a simple bottle design. Only on my first week, but it looks like I will be back for more!

I love this cleanser so much for daily use. I wet my face a bit, put it on while i brush my teeth and rinse feeling so refreshed and my skin is brighter. If you leave it on longer with a lighter layer, it definitely acts as a "Mask" and feels like it pulls out from my pores - i use it this way probably once a week. Will continue to rebuy.
First time I write a review about a cleanser, I am obsessed with this one, It feels so good on my skin, going to get another one because I don't want to run out.

I think the formulation of this cleanser is really special, it feels so silky and luxurious. It is gentle and leaves my skin clean and ready for the next step. I notice that "clean" refreshed feeling more so than with previous ones, but it's not a stripping feeling either. It feels like an intentional part of my routine and makes me appreciate the cleansing step more. So far it is my favorite that I've tried in that regard. However, I am not a big fan of the smell. It smells a bit like artificial grapefruit, and I think the smell aspect is an important part of the experience to me. It's just not the vibe I'm looking for in my skincare / shower. I prefer scents that are more herbal like rosemary or mugwort. Because of this, I do not plan on repurchasing unless an unscented / revised / differently-scented version is released. Thank you David and goodlight team!

This cleanser is the best one I've ever used. I normally veer away from gel to foam cleansers as I have sensitive skin. The very first time I used this my skin felt clean yet hydrated and I was extremely surprised!! I will definitely keep this in my routine from now on. I am very grateful to have stumbled upon this brand and excited to try the rest of the line out.

avis.titre: This has no right to be this good
avis.texte: It's a pain to try and find a good cleanser when you have skin that's both sensitive AND acne prone. All the acne cleansers are too harsh, and most of the sensitive skin cleansers don't cleanse your skin enough. I picked this one up because I liked the bottle and the overall vibe and I could not be happier that I bought something for the aesthetic. Pros: - No fragrance added and no detectable scent, beyond light eau de soap - You only need a teeny tiny amount for your whole face - A gel that lathers well, but into a waterier foam, so it doesn't get everywhere like sudsier soaps do and also doesn't come out of the bottle REALLY FAST like many gel soaps do - Makes my skin feel clean and refreshed without also feeling tight and stripped I can't speak to the impact of this cleanser on overall skin health & its effect on acne because I haven't been using it long enough. However, in terms of immediate feel, scent, aesthetic, and irritation level, I'd give it a 10/10.

Hands down my favorite product! I'm lazy about cleaning my face. I need it to be an easy, fast but totally cleansed face. This does it all and my face is never dry. Love the way it lathers without fragrance. Now I look forward to cleansing my face.

avis.titre: Cosmic Dew is my new fave!
avis.texte: I can't say enough amazing things about this cleanser. I have pretty sensitive skin and break-out easily but had no problem at all with this. It takes off my mascara and liner with ease as well. A little bit goes a loooooong way!
Just what my skin needs! It's moisturizing and leaves my skin clean but not feeling stripped. Instead it feels supple! The low pH is also lovely for my skin barrier. Would definitely recommend!

I initially bought this cleanser from SokoGlam after getting recommended it from their skin consultation service. When I saw that Ulta had picked up the brand good light, I was SO excited. I've tried so many different cleansers. I currently bounce between this cleanser for the colder months, and the Laneige Moist Cream cleanser. For reference, I have oily/combo skin. Loads of oil and texture in my t-zone with relatively normal, sometimes dry areas around my outer face. I tend to get a ton of flaking on my nose despite it being oily, so I opt for a nice double cleanse to really shell of the dead skin (gently of course,) and I follow up with niacinamide serum, a bit of hyaluronic acid where it's needed, a good quality light-weight moisturizer, and ofc sunscreen during the day. This one from good light is absolutely perfect for my skin during the dryer cold months. It provides a nice lather without being super foamy (due to the lack of harsh surfactants) and leaves my skin feeling clean, but bouncy and refreshed. A little goes a very long way (truly less than a dime sized amount,) and the product tends to last me the entirety of fall and winter with some to spare. For how much product you're using and how much comes in the bottle, it is well worth the price point.

I have been looking for a new cleanser and was really hoping this cleanser would be it because the ingredients look good but when I used it my face was left with huge red marks so if you have sensitive skin I DO NOT recommend this

avis.titre: The only cleanser that didn‚Äôt leave me tight/dry!
avis.texte: Tried so many cleansers, & became nearly convinced that all cleansers sucked on me. I have really annoying skin, where I can get dry and itchy super easily. Normal skin, but things can make me break out too. Even super popular Hydrating CERAVE cleanser makes me itch. But, I tried this out as a mask and a cleanser (2 in 1!), and had no itch or tight feeling in either case. It even cleans off mascara! The style of the tube is really cool as well and looks great with my other products. I wish it were more within my budget, like $10-14, but I understand the price as it is now.

Absolutely impressed and in love with the cosmic dew water cleanser. My skin is so happy, soft, and nourished. I can't think of any other cleanser that compares to the clean feeling as well as keeping the skin so balanced and hydrated. Also very happy with how little product goes so far and the double use as a hydrating mask. Thanks for this great new staple for me, please keep it up!

I wasn't expecting much from the cleanser relative to the other items from Good Light (I was more interested in the toner and serum), but it actually ended up being my favorite of all the items I got when buying the set! The gel has a great consistency and is super foamy when rinsed which makes it an enjoyable product to use, and my skin looks better after using it. It isn't quite as non-stripping as I would like, as it leaves more of a "squeaky clean" feeling afterwards, but it's still fairly gentle. I have extremely dry skin after using tretinoin in the past, though, so your mileage may vary. If you have to try one item from Good Light, I would definitely recommend this one!

I've always been someone who thought "doesn't matter what cleanser I use, it's going to be washed off anyways," and I do still believe that to an extent. I would usually just alternate to a different cleanser once the one I was currently using ran out...but I don't think I'll be doing that when this beauty runs dry! I LOVE this cleanser (and all of the good light products I've tried). It's effective, I feel clean after using it, but not stripped or dry. I think that my favorite thing about this cleanser, however, is that you barely have to use any!!! Just a little pea-sized amount is perfect to clean your whole face. I feel that with other cleansers I need a whole pump or two! Great ingredients, efficacy, allows me to be frugal/buy less frequently, AND I just love this company so much. Incredible products with a meaningful mission. I am die-hard for this cleanser, the toner, and the new moon balm. I also love the serum, but haven't used it as frequently as the others. I also plan to try the new "order of the eclipse" moisturizing cream. I recommend this company to anybody who will listen to me hah. Only thing I have that's a slight negative for this cleanser is the instructions say you can use it as a hydrating mask - I have found this to be untrue. I tried it once and my skin didn't feel any different. This was the only time using this product that my skin felt stripped, so opposite of hydrating. Just felt like I used a bunch of the product for no reason and was hard to get

My favorite cleanser that makes my combination skin feel bouncy and not tight from being stripped of moisture. One tube will last for a while, don't need a lot to get a good foaming lather going. I've restocked this item a few times, more than I've had with any other foam cleanser.
I love a product where a little goes a long way and here you go! It's got a softness as well to it and washes clean, leaving your face feeling refreshed and happy.

avis.titre: Best Cleanser for Dry and Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I tried many cleansers in the past that didn't quite work on my skin type. They would either strip the moisture on my skin or lead to sensitivity. I have been using this one for about two weeks and think I have found the right cleanser for my skin type.
This is the first cleanser I've ever used until it was gone. My skin has improved so much. Blemishes are rare and when they do pop up they are gone super fast.
I'm so happy with GoodLight Cleanser! Super hydrating. I feel my skin much more stronger now!
I love that it leaves my skin feeling perfectly hydrated and clean
This cleanser works so well for my oily, acne prone, sensitive skin. Glad I found this one.

From the first use, this cleanser has changed the feel of my skin, I'm obsessed!!! I have oily combination skin, and this left my skin feeling plump and baby soft, It's so good and I highly recommend it! Can't wait to try the rest of Good Lights products!

As my skin is getting older, I am looking to find skincare that will add beneficial moisture as well as tackle the onslaught of maskne. I finally decided to give this cleanser a whirl and I am so glad I did! The formula is like a rich gel, but it cleanses so deeply when massaged on the face. I've been using it for a few weeks now and I'm not getting as many breakouts as before! Bless you good light.
This is amazing. A little goes a long way and my face feels so fresh and clean when I'm done. I'm in love

I got the cosmic dew water cleanser to take on a trip as an alternative to my fresh soy face cleanser. It's not quite as gentle as the fresh cleanser but still fairy gentle! I wouldn't call it drying but it definitely gets my skin squeaky clean the way an acne cleanser would. I've still been too nervous to use it on my eyelids but so far, using it around my eyes has been fine, no stinging. Overall, I like it, especially for my oily t-zone.

I am truly in love with the cosmic dew water cleanser. Okay, I know that I'm a co-founder of this brand, but a year later and my skin has never been the same. It's baby soft with an amazingly hydrated dry down – I've NEVER experienced that from a cleanser! It's also so, so, soothing as a hydrating mask. This all makes sense since it has glycerin (delicious!), HA (thank you, hydration!), laminaria japonica (the most hydrating of seaweed species, there are 11!), vitamin E (for soothing!) and so much more. I especially love the unique color that comes out. In light it reflects colors like sapphire, topaz, gold, turquoise – so cosmic. Okay, that's all I have to say. I am still a fan of this product one year later + 2 years of testing / formulating this. So proud and so much love. -David
great gentle cleanser ! i love the gel texture and the slip it has to it. 10/10

avis.titre: Great Cleanser, but Packaging is rough for me
avis.texte: first off, the cleanser itself is very effective and gentle. I use it fairly often as a shower mask, and love it! it's very sticky when "dry" and then becomes very foamy and has a nice slip once you wet it. however, there is a downside and it's the tube itself. At first, i had to squeeze the tube really tight to get any product out (like the hole was really small) and it hurt my hands. Then, a small piece of plastic broke off the hole, and now it dispenses much easier but it leaks all over the place and fills up the cap, so i have to store it upside down. It's not that big of a deal—more of a comfort and convenience thing. If i got a faulty tube, then no worries, but if this very small hole is a design feature, then i request a different design!

i just received my cosmic dew water cleanser today and with just the first use, i can say with confidence that i'm already in love with it! i actually think this might be my new go-to cleanser. it's so unbelievably gentle on the skin yet cleanses your skin of EVERYTHING, whether it's dirt or leftover makeup (i used it as a double cleanser after removing my makeup!). after rinsing, your skin just feels unbelievably clean yet hydrated, which is something i love about this cleanser. the texture is amazing as well and it suds up so nicely, which is something that actually amazed me because most gel-to-foam cleansers i've used in the past only foam up only after you exert a bit of elbow grease into working it into a lather, but this one bubbled up so nicely, and a little goes a long way! i also have really sensitive, acne prone skin, so most new cleansers that i try out will leave my skin feeling dry or a little irritated, but this cleanser didn't irritate my skin at all. to make it even better, this cleanser has no scent to it!
Doesn't feel like it stripped my skin leaves a nice smooth and hydrated feeling on the skin. A bonus for using as a hydration mask makes my beard hair super soft and easy to shave

Okay so I am not one to write reviews at all. But let me tell you this cleanser is the bees knees. I bought it along with the moon milk toner and am completely obsessed with both. I've only had them for 4 or 5 days and the difference I see and feel in my skin is insane. It's so soft and glowy and clear. I can tell that my skin barrier is improving. It sounds dramatic but I will never be buying another cleanser or toner besides these ever again. 11/10. Y'all did the dang thing! Love it!!
Would buy again . It's a good price and it's worth the purchase.

Love this so much! I only need a pea sized amount to get a great lather and it leaves my face feeling great. So gentle but definitely cleans everything off. I don't have that tight skin feeling after I use it, but instead my skin feels light and hydrated. I will for sure be buying this again. Thank you so much for this line of simple but powerful products! I owe my glowy skin to you!

I am in LOVE with the cleanser. Currently using up my third tube and planning to order more. My skin was not in the best condition, therefore I was looking for a gentle cleanser that would not leave my damaged skin stripped and dry. My skin loves it and so do I.

I have combination skin and this cleanser is gentle enough with my dry areas but effective enough to remove makeup! I am very happy I bought it. A little goes a long way (I only use a pea size amount) and the foam makes it easier to wash the whole face. It's a must in my shower.

This is the most fantastic cleanser I have ever used. It leaves my skin clean but not at all stripped. I have dry skin and have been struggling with dryness this winter. Not anymore. And it's great used as a moisturizing mask too. This product has not broken me out at all either. My skin has never looked better.
A gentle but powerful cleanser. It gets the job done and feels lovely doing it!

avis.titre: team sensitive, this one's for us!
avis.texte: When I say this is the best cleanser ever, I'm not exaggerating at all. I've tried soooo many, all different formulas, and this sensitive acne prone skin has rejected most of them. This one is beautiful, it foams just the right amount and leaves you squeaky clean without feeling stripped or dehydrated; just balanced and deeply cleansed! I'd say the closest bigger name cleanser I've tried is Herbivore Pink Cloud, but this one does a better job at cleansing deeply and is unscented. Overall, 1000/10 will buy forever.

I recently purchased this product after trying the milky toning lotion and it is everything I want and need in a cleanser. Lightweight, non-sticky, with a clean very subtle smell. The light foaming action cleans my face and neck without drying my skin. I use it on a daily basis and see a difference in my skin just after a week. I can't wait to see how my skin looks after using this for a month. Thank you for bringing me into the light!

Just looked up online and found this. Was a bit skeptical to take the risk of buying it. But it is perfect. It does foam, does not leave the face dry and also comes very little when you squeeze the tube. So, just a little is good and handful.

I am 41 and have been struggling with acne very recently, never had an issue until now. I have tried every cleanser out there and every single one left my skin feeling tight and dry. I tried this one after hearing an episode of the Double Cleanse podcast with the creator of this brand. I loved the philosophy behind the brand and decided to give it a try. It has been the best decision I have ever made. My skin feels soft and hydrated ever time I use it. The bottle seems small but you really only need the tiniest amount, and it lasts me longer than most cleansers. I will always purchase this from now on. Love it so much. Thank you!

I've been trying all sorts of cleansers (some in the $65+ range) and nothing comes close to this! It completely removes my waterproof eyeliner with the upmost ease and leaves my sensitive dry skin feeling refreshed but not stripped. I've noticed an improvement in my skin texture and overall clarity; I could not be more thrilled! I live in an area where mask wearing is still required indoors and it has been so hard to get my skin feeling clean over the past year and a half, this product has been a total gamechanger for me.

For years I've been looking for the right cleanser. Like 10 cleansers later I saw this on one of James Welch's YouTube videos and I had to try it and I'm in love . I stocked up recently. I even recommend this to my sister. It's so gentle but yet removes makeup and cleanses your skin with irritation not over stripping your skin.

Confession: I'm a cleanser snob. I know what I like & what I don't. This cleanser is my absolute favorite. The crystal clear gel lathers into a super gentle, but effective foam. It leaves my skin feeling clean & hydrated. I'm obsessed. Don't buy one...buy three! You won't regret it.
Even bought another one for my mom who has sensitive skin for the holidays. I've gone through an entire tube so far myself the past few months and have loved it. Tried and tested - approved!

This cleanser lives up to the hype and more. After adding water, the cleanser foams up like no other creating a creamy lather that not only cleanses the face beautifully, but also insanely moisturizes it. I didn't know I was missing out on something until I tried this. Highly HIGHLY recommend.
This is the best cleanser I've found that really does the job without either irritating my sensitive skin or causing me to break out. And it's a great price too!

avis.titre: Does not dry out my thirsty skin
avis.texte: Lovely cleanser. I only use it in the pm, after an oil cleanser. I like to apply it before I get in the shower and leave it on until the very end. My skin is clean, smooth and plump. Love it!

I love, love this product. It's like Glossier's Milk Jelly Cleanser but better. It feels like it truly both cleans and moisturizes your skin. I also love that when I rub it into my face, I can see the lather - it feels like it's really working. I bought these products on a whim, trying to support AAPI small businesses, but this was way better than I expected. I will definitely be coming back!

This cleanser is fragrance free and gentle enough for my super sensitive skin. After washing, my face feels clean but not tight or dry. I've only been using it for a couple of weeks, but so far I'm loving it!

I needed to find a new cleanser after the one I had been using for almost a year started breaking me out. I was looking for something gentle and fragrance free. I figured I would try K beauty since everything else breaks me out. Anyways, I'm extremely acne prone and have hyper sensitive skin. THIS is AMAZING. I initially had a little bit of purging, nothing crazy and it cleared up after the 2nd week. My face is less red and irritated and honestly….. my face has hardly broken out since using this. My skin looks the healthiest it has in a long time. Please don't ever change the formula! it does everything it claims. You only need a small amount and it goes a LONG way. Which I appreciate! This is my new holy grail! Which for an acne suffer is hard to say. My face is sooo smooth and virtually extremely clear from what I'm used to. So glad I found this! Defiantly repurchasing!
I love the fact that I am hydrating my skin while cleaning it! This cleanser is amazing, I highly recommend it!

I've struggled with acne for a good chunk of my life until I was introduced to probiotic skincare. Finding a good probiotic face wash was a concern of mine but the search is over. I've used this product for over three months now and I won't be going back to anything else. Thank you for making such an awesome product.

avis.titre: Most Calming and Healing Cleanser I Have Ever Used!
avis.texte: When I first tried this cleanser, I was leaving for a long road trip. To make things easier, I decided to use only this Cosmic Dew Water Cleanser, along with a toner and moisturizer from Glow Recipe. I expected my skin would be fine, even though I usually use more than just three products. Well, I could not even believe how healing this cleanser was. It literally eliminated all inflammation from my face. If I did get any sort of breakout, it didn't get red at all, and disappeared almost immediately. I was shocked. I agree with every good thing said in all of the other reviews. Also, one way that I like to use it is to put a lot on my face in the shower, but very gently so that it stays a gel and doesn't lather. Then after a few minutes, when I rinse it off, my skin is so unbelievably soft.

This feels so great and luxurious. The smell bothered me at first, not because it was bad but because it reminded me of a drink that I couldn't figure out but once I got past that and focused on the texture and results. I was sold. I really like this cleanser and it rivals my other current favorite. My skin feels so clean and soft without being stripped after and using it feels dreamy. Love this!
Scent, texture, hydration, cleanliness - this feels made for my skin - fits my minimal routine perfectly. Packaging looks great amongst other products as well!

I usually use a Micellar water to take make-up off, then do a cleanser. Even then I've noticed all my make-up is not removed. The Cosmic Dew Water cleanser does the trick! I love the subtle fresh smell. It goes from gel to foam quickly and it's so effective and refreshing. Highly recommend!
